$comment: Declared versions NOT published from this repository, each with the reason.
State is computed from this repository's git tags. a1 and a2 were published
from dotmac_starter_mt and their tags stay there permanently.
The 0.1.0a13 row that sat here between the declaration and the publication
was removed by the RECORDER, as a8 through a12 were — the gesture a human
forgot twice (a4 by six silent hours, a7 loudly at every open pull request)
is now the verify run's own last act.
0.1.0a3 is published and permanently unpinnable; 0.1.0a4 and 0.1.0a5 are
published, verified, and refused for adoption; 0.1.0a6 through 0.1.0a12
remain published and verified; 0.1.0a13 is published, independently verified,
and is the version to pin for the Control-owned trust registry and its public
read-only facade. All of them live in docs/published-versions.json,
each superseding disposition APPENDED to its original record rather than
replacing it.
A row here and a row in docs/published-versions.json are never both true
about one version at once, and
test_the_ledger_and_the_published_record_never_claim_the_same_version states
that over the two FILES so it holds even in a tagless checkout.
EMPTY: every version this tree declares is now either recorded in
docs/published-versions.json or represented by a source tag. A future
allocation adds its row here before any source for that version is published.
